intro.text: A bridgeman of Bridge Four who serves as a guard for the Kholin family.

items.text: Kaladin took Mart, Eth, Moash and Drehy to guard Dalinar and the king at the Pinnacle, posting Eth and Mart on the door with orders to admit no one but a highprince without permission. Another time Mart and Natam guarded Navani while Kaladin confronted Dalinar.

When Szeth attacked Dalinar, Mart and Eth were assigned to guard the king, and afterwards Mart and Moash watched the door to the king's chambers. Mart and Eth also guarded Adolin during Kaladin's Shardblade training.
Mart and Pedin were killed by Szeth during the Battle of Narak.
